identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase III Study of Lenalidomide and Dexamethasone With or Without Elotuzumab to Treat Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase 3, Randomized, Open Label Trial of Lenalidomide/Dexamethasone With or Without Elotuzumab in Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma (MM)

interventions.name: Lenalidomide
interventions.description: Capsules, Oral, 25 mg, once daily, on Days 1-21, Repeat every 28 days until subject meets criteria for discontinuation of study drug

interventions.name: Dexamethasone
interventions.description: Tablets, Oral, 40 mg, weekly, on Days 1, 8, 15, 22, Repeat every 28 days until subject meets criteria for discontinuation of study drug

interventions.name: Dexamethasone (Oral)
interventions.description:
On weeks without Elotuzumab dosing: Tablets, Oral, 40mg, Repeat every 28 days until subject meets criteria for discontinuation of study drug.

On weeks with Elotuzumab dosing: Tablets, Oral, 28 mg, Repeat every 28 days until subject meets criteria for discontinuation of study drug

interventions.name: Dexamethasone (IV)
interventions.description:
On weeks without Elotuzumab dosing: Not Applicable (N/A)

On weeks with Elotuzumab dosing: Solution, Intravenous (IV), 8 mg, weekly, Repeat every 28 days until subject meets criteria for discontinuation of study drug

interventions.name: Elotuzumab (BMS-901608; HuLuc63)
interventions.description: Solution, IV, 10 mg/kg, weekly, on Days 1, 8, 15, 22 (cycles 1\&2); Days 1 and 15 (cycles 3 and beyond), Repeat every 28 days until subject meets criteria for discontinuation of study drug
